title: Can the request budget survive its hottest partition?
description: Choose a workload, then change traffic, regional RU/s, key skew, region count, and read consistency. The model separates aggregate pressure from the hot-partition limit that account-level capacity can hide.

consistencies.label: Strong
consistencies.detail: Linearizable reads use quorum coordination and approximately twice the RU of relaxed reads in this teaching model.

consistencies.label: Bounded staleness
consistencies.detail: Readers stay within a configured version or time lag, with the stronger-read throughput cost.

consistencies.label: Session
consistencies.detail: A session token provides read-your-writes and monotonic reads within the client session.

consistencies.label: Consistent prefix
consistencies.detail: Readers can lag, but they do not observe writes out of order.

consistencies.label: Eventual
consistencies.detail: Replicas converge without an ordering or freshness guarantee for an individual read.

profiles.label: Customer order state
profiles.detail: Point-heavy reads and writes partitioned by customer or tenant.

profiles.label: Global product catalog
profiles.detail: Read-heavy point access with a small query share and several read regions.

profiles.label: Status-key anti-pattern
profiles.detail: A low-cardinality status key concentrates most writes in one key range.
